email.subject: Biscuit - food trial results
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

Thanks for keeping such a good log. Biscuit's itching and ear redness came back within 3 days of the chicken challenge and cleared again on the fish diet, which confirms a chicken allergy.

Plan:
- Stay on Natural Balance L.I.D. Sweet Potato & Fish.
- Avoid chicken in every form: chicken meal, chicken fat, chicken broth, and chicken or poultry flavoring in treats, chews and supplements. Check labels on anything new.
- If his ears flare again, call us before starting any leftover drops.

I've added the allergy to his chart.

Dr. Anita Kowalski
Lakeview Animal Hospital

email.subject: Tom - re-eval and home exercises
email.body:
Hi Hannah and Ben,

Tom did well at his re-eval today. He's walking about 300 feet with the walker and doing stairs with one rail, step-to pattern. Goals for the next 7 weeks: cane indoors, stairs step-over-step with the rail, and getting in and out of a car without help.

Home exercises, once a day on non-PT days (Tue, Thu, weekends):
- Heel slides, 2 x 10
- Glute sets, 2 x 10, hold 5 sec
- Standing hip abduction at the counter, 2 x 10
- Sit to stand from a firm chair, 2 x 8

He's still on hip precautions until Dr. Halpern clears him: no crossing legs, no bending past 90 degrees. Keep the raised toilet seat for now.

He admitted he's been skipping the sit-to-stands. A nudge from you two would help.

Jenna Park, PT, DPT
Northwestern Rehab Outpatient Therapy

email.subject: Lakeview Paws - October: Halloween safety and dog flu
email.body:
Halloween candy, especially anything with chocolate or xylitol, is the number one reason for our October emergency calls. Keep candy bowls up high and take costumes off pets that seem stressed.

Canine influenza: we're seeing cases from local daycares and boarding. The two-dose vaccine is $42 per dose; ask at your next visit.

New Saturday hours: 8 AM to 2 PM starting October 3.

Refills: heartworm and flea/tick prescriptions can be ordered through our online pharmacy or approved for Chewy within one business day.

turns.text: Can you give me a list of dog treats without chicken? Biscuit's allergic, even to chicken flavoring.

Some to look at: Zuke's Mini Naturals Salmon, Whimzees (vegetable-based chews), and single-ingredient fish skins like dehydrated salmon skin. Plain pumpkin, carrots and apple slices without seeds also work. Formulas change, so check each label for chicken, chicken meal, chicken fat, chicken broth and poultry or natural flavor before you buy.
Add pumpkin and carrots and save it as a note. I'll fill in the rest after I check labels.

Three options fit: a cottage on Griffith St hosted by Linnea, $452 total, 5-minute walk to downtown, free cancellation until Oct 31; a studio above a shop on Butler St, $398 but street parking only; and a 2-bedroom near Oval Beach at $489, which is a 20-minute walk to town.
